metadata.title: Logistics between Ireland and Cameroon
metadata.description: Request a quote and track shipments between Ireland and Cameroon. Every quote is reviewed by our team.

hero.title: Air and sea freight between Ireland and Cameroon
hero.subtitle: Parcels, barrels, vehicles, containers and commercial goods in both directions, with customs clearance, storage and online-shopping forwarding when you need them. Tell us what you are sending and we will prepare a quote for your shipment.

services.heading: Our services
services.intro: Shipping by air and sea in both directions, and the customs, storage and shopping services that go with it. If what you need is not listed, ask us.

process.heading: How a quote works
process.step1Title: Tell us what you are sending
process.step1Body: Use the quote form: what the goods are, roughly how much, where they are now and where they need to go.
process.step2Body: If anything is unclear, we contact you before setting a price, so the quote matches what you actually send.
process.step3Body: The price, what it includes and how long it is valid. You decide whether to accept it; nothing is paid online.
process.step4Body: Once booked, your shipment gets an ML reference that you and the recipient can track.

about.heading: About Marchelo Logistics
about.body: Marchelo Logistics ships goods for families and businesses between Ireland and Cameroon, in English and in French.

guide.heading: Packing for a long journey
guide.body: Good packing protects your goods at sea and on the road. Read our guide to packing barrels and boxes, labelling them and listing what is inside.

final.heading: Talk to us in Ireland or in Cameroon
final.body: For a price, the quote form is the quickest way to send us the details we need. For anything else, call or write to us.

aboutPage.title: About us
aboutPage.intro: Marchelo Logistics is a logistics and freight-forwarding business working between Ireland and Cameroon, with an office in Lucan and a base in Douala.
aboutPage.howWeWork: Every quote is prepared by a member of our team for your specific shipment. Prices are never calculated automatically.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers about using this website. For questions about a specific shipment, contact us.
faq.q1: How do I get a price?
faq.a1: Send a quote request with details of what you want to ship. Our team reviews it and sends you a quote. Prices are not calculated automatically.
faq.a2: No. You can request a quote and track a shipment without an account.
faq.q3: Where do I find my tracking reference?
faq.a3: Shipment references start with ML and are given to you when your shipment is booked. Quote request references start with QR.
faq.a4: Some items cannot be shipped. Describe your items in your request and our team will tell you if anything cannot be carried.
faq.a5: You can use the website in English or French.
faq.a6: We run an express shipment every month in each direction. The departure windows are:

privacyPage.title: Privacy information
privacyPage.draftNotice: Draft: this page describes what the website technically collects. The data controller details and retention periods are awaiting confirmation.
privacyPage.collect: When you request a quote: your name, email address, phone number (optional), the route and details of the items you describe, and your preferred language. When you have an account: your sign-in email and the records linked to it. Uploaded documents, if you choose to provide them.
privacyPage.use: To prepare and send your quote, to arrange and track your shipment, to contact you about it, and to keep a secure record of changes.
privacyPage.security: Data is stored in a database hosted in the European Union. Access is limited to you and to authorised staff. Documents are private and shared only through short-lived links.
privacyPage.cookies: We use only the cookies needed for language preference and, when you sign in, to keep you signed in. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.
privacyPage.retention: Retention periods are being confirmed. Until then, nothing is deleted automatically.
privacyPage.rights: You can ask to access, correct or delete your personal data. Contact us using the details on our contact page.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: From your first request to delivery at the destination, here is what happens and what we need from you at each stage.
howItWorks.step1Body: Use the quote form to tell us what you want to send. The more detail you give, the more accurate your quote.
howItWorks.step1Point1: What the items are and how many
howItWorks.step1Point2: Approximate size and weight, if you know them
howItWorks.step1Point3: Where the goods are now and where they need to go
howItWorks.step2Body: A member of our team checks your request. If something is missing or unclear, we ask you before preparing a price, so you are not quoted for the wrong thing.
howItWorks.step3Body: Your quote shows the price, the currency, how long it stays valid, and what is included and excluded. You decide whether to accept it. Nothing is charged automatically.
howItWorks.step4Body: Once you accept, we agree with you how and when your goods are handed over for your shipment.
howItWorks.step5Body: Your shipment gets an ML reference. Each time our team records a step, it appears on the tracking page. These are the steps a shipment can go through:
howItWorks.step5Exceptions: If something holds a shipment up, it is shown as “Delayed” or “On hold”, and our team will explain what is happening.
howItWorks.step6Title: 6. Delivery or collection at the destination
howItWorks.step6Body: When your goods are ready, the tracking page shows whether they are ready for collection or out for delivery.

guide.title: Shipping guide
guide.intro: Practical advice for packing and preparing goods for the long journey between Ireland and Cameroon. This is general guidance: your quote confirms the details for your shipment.
guide.packing1: Use strong, rigid barrels or double-walled boxes. Old, soft boxes can collapse under the weight of other cargo.
guide.packing2: Put heavy items at the bottom and lighter items on top.
guide.packing3: Fill empty spaces with clothes, towels or packing material so nothing moves.
guide.packing4: Wrap fragile items individually and keep them away from the sides.
guide.packing5: Seal liquids in plastic bags in case a lid opens.
guide.packing6: Close barrels with their locking ring and tape every box seam.
guide.label1: Write the sender’s and the receiver’s full names and phone numbers on every barrel and box.
guide.label2: Number your pieces, for example 1 of 3, 2 of 3, 3 of 3.
guide.label3: Once your shipment is booked, add your ML reference to every piece.
guide.listBody: Write down what is in each barrel or box and its approximate value. You will need this information for your quote request and it helps if customs ask questions.
guide.restrictedBody: Some goods can never be shipped and others need special handling. Do not pack any of the following without asking us first:
guide.restricted1: Flammable liquids, gas cylinders, aerosols and fuel
guide.restricted3: Weapons, ammunition and anything that looks like them
guide.restrictedNote: The final list for your shipment is confirmed in your quote.
guide.customsBody: Goods arriving in Cameroon or Ireland may be subject to customs checks, duties and taxes. Your quote states what is included and what is not, so ask us if anything is unclear.
